speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cushing's Syndrome complicated by Pulmonary Hypertension and Cor Pulmonale. DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Acute exacerbation of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
